tasks.goal: Evaluate real task/agent orchestration tools for detecting and recovering failed worker tasks. Focus on tools usable in this environment (Paperclip, Hermes, CLI patterns) and state exact candidate tool, evidence, installation/use viability. Do not install or modify anything. Report recommended approach and a minimal safe isolated test.

Review design scope for Plaesy Advisor Council: compare arbitrary options and multi-perspective deliberation, implementable requirements, safety boundaries, and realistic simulations. Do not edit source. Use observed Plaesy existing architecture only if accessible; list precise gaps and acceptance tests.
